Hepatic subcellular shift: 105000g supernatant (cytosol) held 3% of hepatic PFOA at low dose vs 43% at high dose. Biliary excretion index rose with hepatic concentration.
authors_interpretation: Authors: "PFOA is preferentially taken-up by the liver, and distributed to membrane fractions, especially 18000g pellet, and hardly excreted into bile when exposed at very low dose." Direction: apparent Vd is LARGER at low dose because more of the body burden sits outside plasma.
